mapper.insert: INSERT INTO s_activity_report ( report_date,activity_id,market_site_id,market_team_id,marketer_id, accept_user_count,accept_times,trigger_user_count,trigger_times,receive_reward_user_count, receive_reward_times,receive_reward_amt) SELECT p.proc_date, p.activity_id, u.market_site_id, u.market_team_id, u.marketer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(p.proc_type = 0,p.user_id,NULL)) acceptUserCount, COUNT( CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 0 THEN 1 END ) AS acceptTimes, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(p.proc_type = 1,p.user_id,NULL)) triggerUserCount, COUNT( CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 1 THEN 1 END ) AS triggerTimes, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(p.proc_type = 2,p.user_id,NULL)) receiveRewardUserCount, COUNT( CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 2 THEN 1 END ) AS receiveRewardTimes, COALESCE ( SUM( CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 2 THEN p.receive_amt END ), 0 ) AS receiveRewardAmt FROM p_activity_proc p INNER JOIN s_user u ON u.id = p.user_id AND u.user_type != 1 WHERE p.id BETWEEN #{fromId} AND #{toId} GROUP BY p.proc_date, p.activity_id, u.market_site_id, u.market_team_id, u.marketer_id ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE accept_user_count = IFNULL(accept_user_count,0) + VALUES(accept_user_count), accept_times = IFNULL(accept_times,0) + VALUES(accept_times), trigger_user_count = IFNULL(trigger_user_count,0) + VALUES(trigger_user_count), trigger_times = IFNULL(trigger_times,0) + VALUES(trigger_times), receive_reward_user_count = IFNULL(receive_reward_user_count,0) + VALUES(receive_reward_user_count), receive_reward_times = IFNULL(receive_reward_times,0) + VALUES(receive_reward_times), receive_reward_amt = IFNULL(receive_reward_amt,0) + VALUES(receive_reward_amt)
